name: sigesa-backend
description: SIGESA backend MVP — Evidence, Audit, Gateway (hexagonal, append-only)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sigesa/shared && npm run build -w @sigesa/evidence-service && npm run build -w @sigesa/audit-service && npm run build -w @sigesa/gateway && npm run build -w @sigesa/orchestration-service
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U sigesa -d sigesa -f /migrations/001_ddl.sql && docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U sigesa -d sigesa -f /migrations/002_supplementary.sql && docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U sigesa -d sigesa -f /scripts/seed-dev.sql
